headline: Built for organizations that cannot send the archive outside the boundary.
body: iDocHive is designed for ministries, authorities, archives, defence-adjacent organizations, infrastructure programs, cultural institutions, financial firms, healthcare providers, and other security-first enterprises.

segments.title: Ministries and authorities
segments.text: Convert circulars, case files, and departmental repositories into permission-aware organizational knowledge.

segments.title: Government archives
segments.text: Digitize historical records, classify them, apply access rules, and retrieve with citations.

segments.title: Defence-adjacent organizations
segments.text: Operate air-gapped or highly restricted document intelligence with signed offline updates and customer-controlled keys.

segments.title: Construction and infrastructure programs
segments.text: Govern drawings, variations, correspondence, and handover records across multi-party projects.

segments.title: Regulated enterprises
segments.text: Keep contracts, policies, and operational records inside an approved private environment.

segments.title: Cultural institutions
segments.text: Protect collection, appraisal, and provenance files with restricted access and research-grade citations.

segments.title: Financial organizations
segments.text: Support obligation tracking and policy answers without a public model path.

segments.title: Healthcare organizations
segments.text: Apply private document intelligence where residency and access rules are non-negotiable.

journey.headline: A procurement path that starts with one collection

concerns.headline: What each owner needs to see

items.title: Security-owner concerns
items.text: No uncontrolled production data path. Identity, keys, SIEM, audit completeness, and air-gap topology.

items.title: Records-owner concerns
items.text: Classification, versions, retention, retrieval quality, and a durable evidence trail.

items.title: Business-owner concerns
items.text: One measurable process: faster search, lower manual processing, and a defined pilot outcome.

items.title: Procurement concerns
items.text: Clear scope. Software, services, infrastructure, and digitization remain separable line items.

items.title: IT infrastructure concerns
items.text: Customer-controlled runtime, PostgreSQL + pgvector, object storage, backup, and a documented handover.

controls.headline: Saudi control mapping, not a blanket certificate
controls.body: Designed to support customer compliance programs and deployment-specific control mapping, including Saudi PDPL, NCA ECC, NCA DCC, and NCA CCC when cloud infrastructure applies. iDocHive does not make an organization compliant by itself.

items.title: Saudi PDPL
items.text: Supports controller and processor clarity, purpose limitation, retention, export logging, and customer-visible subprocessors. On-premise software is not automatically PDPL-compliant.

items.title: NCA ECC
items.text: Maps to governance, defence, resilience, and third-party evidence from identity, access, vulnerability, logging, backup, and incident processes. Tender-specific control versions still apply.

items.title: NCA DCC
items.text: Supports data-lifecycle mapping across classification, handling, storage, transfer, backup, destruction, and monitoring.

items.title: NCA CCC
items.text: Applies when sovereign or private cloud services enter the design. Cloud-provider and tenant responsibilities stay separate.
